title: Substance use and mental health characteristics associated with cognitive functioning among adults who use methamphetamine - PubMed
abstract:
Acute, low-dose methamphetamine administration improves attention/information processing speed and working memory in methamphetamine-dependent individuals displaying poorer cognitive performance at baseline.
This study describes cognitive functioning and its relation to psychiatric and substance use severity among adults with long duration methamphetamine use.
